    s.Store_Name,
    ROUND(AVG(s.Ranking) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.District_ID), 2) AS avg_ranking,
    pc.total_product_count
FROM store s
JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sd_cnt.District_ID,
        COUNT(sp.Product_ID) AS total_product_count
    FROM store_product sp
    JOIN store_district sd_cnt ON sp.Store_ID = sd_cnt.Store_ID
    GROUP BY sd_cnt.District_ID
) pc ON sd.District_ID = pc.District_ID
WHERE d.Headquartered_City LIKE '%Attock%'
ORDER BY sd.District_ID, s.Store_Name
